name: Rusty Blackhaw

facts.how: Raw ripe, or cooked into a preserve

caution: Eat only fully soft, dark, sweet fruit; the flat seed is not eaten. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A small tree with glossy leaves that flare red in autumn and clusters of raisin-sweet blue-black fruit dusted with a pale bloom.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Ripe fruit tastes of dates and prunes; the thin flesh around the seed makes a modest but pleasant preserve.
